title: 2 Samuel, Chapter 22 (Leningrad Codex)
source: Leningrad Codex folios (Internet Archive, WSRP photographs) + tanach.us LC folio index + UXLC Hebrew + KJV
description: 2 Samuel 22 on folios 182r, 182v of the Leningrad Codex (1008 AD), the oldest complete Hebrew Bible. Hebrew from the UXLC transcription of this manuscript; English KJV.
introduction:
2 Samuel chapter 22 from the Leningrad Codex (Codex Leningradensis, National Library of Russia, Firkovich EBP. I B 19a), copied in Cairo by Samuel ben Jacob and dated 1008/1009 AD, the oldest complete manuscript of the Hebrew Bible and the base text of the Biblia Hebraica editions. This chapter stands on folios 182r, 182v.

This entry meets the strict three-criteria standard of the Theosis Library:

  1. Manuscript scan: the specific folio side(s) carrying each section's verses, from the full-colour West Semitic Research Project photographs of the codex as redistributed on Internet Archive (item Leningrad_Codex_Color_Images, marked Creative Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0). Folio-to-verse ranges come from the tanach.us LC folio index, which was derived from the West Semitic Research Project's published index; each section links only to the page(s) whose recorded verse range contains its verses.
  2. Original text: the verbatim Hebrew of this manuscript in the Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC 2.5 build 27.6, tanach.us), a transcription of Firkovich B 19a with vowels and cantillation, released without restriction on the biblical text.
  3. English translation: the King James Version (1611, public domain), retrieved verbatim from bolls.life (KJV text, Strong's numbers stripped).
translator_notes: Ketiv/Qere: where the scribe wrote one form (ketiv) but the Masoretes read another (qere), the consonantal ketiv is given first and the vocalised qere follows in square brackets. פ and ס mark the open and closed paragraph breaks visible as gaps in the manuscript columns.

translation.original_text: <sup>1</sup>וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר דָּוִד֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֖י הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּיוֹם֩ הִצִּ֨יל יְהוָ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל־אֹיְבָ֖יו וּמִכַּ֥ף שָׁאֽוּל׃ <sup>2</sup>וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֛ה סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצֻדָתִ֖י וּמְפַלְטִי־לִֽי׃ <sup>3</sup>אֱלֹהֵ֥י צוּרִ֖י אֶחֱסֶה־בּ֑וֹ מָגִנִּ֞י וְקֶ֣רֶן יִשְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּי֙ וּמְנוּסִ֔י מֹשִׁעִ֕י מֵחָמָ֖ס תֹּשִׁעֵֽנִי׃ <sup>4</sup>מְהֻלָּ֖ל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּמֵאֹיְבַ֖י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃ <sup>5</sup>כִּ֥י אֲפָפֻ֖נִי מִשְׁבְּרֵי־מָ֑וֶת נַחֲלֵ֥י בְלִיַּ֖עַל יְבַעֲתֻֽנִי׃ <sup>6</sup>חֶבְלֵ֥י שְׁא֖וֹל סַבֻּ֑נִי קִדְּמֻ֖נִי מֹֽקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃ <sup>7</sup>בַּצַּר־לִי֙ אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֔ה וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַ֖י אֶקְרָ֑א וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע מֵהֵֽיכָלוֹ֙ קוֹלִ֔י וְשַׁוְעָתִ֖י בְּאָזְנָֽיו׃ <sup>8</sup>ותגעש [וַיִתְגָּעַ֤שׁ] וַתִּרְעַשׁ֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ מוֹסְד֥וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַיִּֽתְגָּעֲשׁ֖וּ כִּֽי־חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ׃
translation.text: <sup>1</sup>And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul: <sup>2</sup>And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; <sup>3</sup>The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence. <sup>4</sup>I will call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies. <sup>5</sup>When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid; <sup>6</sup>The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me; <sup>7</sup>In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears. <sup>8</sup>Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.

translation.original_text: <sup>9</sup>עָלָ֤ה עָשָׁן֙ בְּאַפּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֥שׁ מִפִּ֖יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּחָלִ֖ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃ <sup>10</sup>וַיֵּ֥ט שָׁמַ֖יִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַעֲרָפֶ֖ל תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽיו׃ <sup>11</sup>וַיִּרְכַּ֥ב עַל־כְּר֖וּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַיֵּרָ֖א עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רֽוּחַ׃ <sup>12</sup>וַיָּ֥שֶׁת חֹ֛שֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָ֖יו סֻכּ֑וֹת חַֽשְׁרַת־מַ֖יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים׃ <sup>13</sup>מִנֹּ֖גַהּ נֶגְדּ֑וֹ בָּעֲר֖וּ גַּחֲלֵי־אֵֽשׁ׃ <sup>14</sup>יַרְעֵ֥ם מִן־שָׁמַ֖יִם יְהוָ֑ה וְעֶלְי֖וֹן יִתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֽוֹ׃ <sup>15</sup>וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח חִצִּ֖ים וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם בָּרָ֖ק ויהמם [וַיָּהֹֽם׃] <sup>16</sup>וַיֵּֽרָאוּ֙ אֲפִ֣קֵי יָ֔ם יִגָּל֖וּ מֹסְד֣וֹת תֵּבֵ֑ל בְּגַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מִנִּשְׁמַ֖ת ר֥וּחַ אַפּֽוֹ׃
translation.text: <sup>9</sup>There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it. <sup>10</sup>He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet. <sup>11</sup>And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind. <sup>12</sup>And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies. <sup>13</sup>Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled. <sup>14</sup>The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice. <sup>15</sup>And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them. <sup>16</sup>And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

translation.original_text: <sup>17</sup>יִשְׁלַ֥ח מִמָּר֖וֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽמְשֵׁ֖נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃ <sup>18</sup>יַצִּילֵ֕נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֖י עָ֑ז מִשֹּׂ֣נְאַ֔י כִּ֥י אָמְצ֖וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃ <sup>19</sup>יְקַדְּמֻ֖נִי בְּי֣וֹם אֵידִ֑י וַיְהִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה מִשְׁעָ֖ן לִֽי׃ <sup>20</sup>וַיֹּצֵ֥א לַמֶּרְחָ֖ב אֹתִ֑י יְחַלְּצֵ֖נִי כִּי־חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי׃ <sup>21</sup>יִגְמְלֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָדַ֖י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי׃ <sup>22</sup>כִּ֥י שָׁמַ֖רְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א רָשַׁ֖עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי׃ <sup>23</sup>כִּ֥י כָל־משפטו [מִשְׁפָּטָ֖יו] לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו לֹא־אָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃ <sup>24</sup>וָאֶהְיֶ֥ה תָמִ֖ים ל֑וֹ וָאֶשְׁתַּמְּרָ֖ה מֵעֲוֺנִֽי׃
translation.text: <sup>17</sup>He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters; <sup>18</sup>He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me. <sup>19</sup>They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay. <sup>20</sup>He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me. <sup>21</sup>The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me. <sup>22</sup>For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God. <sup>23</sup>For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them. <sup>24</sup>I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.

translation.original_text: <sup>25</sup>וַיָּ֧שֶׁב יְהוָ֛ה לִ֖י כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹרִ֖י לְנֶ֥גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃ <sup>26</sup>עִם־חָסִ֖יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם־גִּבּ֥וֹר תָּמִ֖ים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃ <sup>27</sup>עִם־נָבָ֖ר תִּתָּבָ֑ר וְעִם־עִקֵּ֖שׁ תִּתַּפָּֽל׃ <sup>28</sup>וְאֶת־עַ֥ם עָנִ֖י תּוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינֶ֥יךָ עַל־רָמִ֖ים תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃ <sup>29</sup>כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה נֵירִ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וַיהוָ֖ה יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי׃ <sup>30</sup>כִּ֥י בְכָ֖ה אָר֣וּץ גְּד֑וּד בֵּאלֹהַ֖י אֲדַלֶּג־שֽׁוּר׃ <sup>31</sup>הָאֵ֖ל תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכּ֑וֹ אִמְרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ צְרוּפָ֔ה מָגֵ֣ן ה֔וּא לְכֹ֖ל הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃ <sup>32</sup>כִּ֥י מִי־אֵ֖ל מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֖וּר מִֽבַּלְעֲדֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation.text: <sup>25</sup>Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight. <sup>26</sup>With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright. <sup>27</sup>With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury. <sup>28</sup>And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down. <sup>29</sup>For thou art my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness. <sup>30</sup>For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall. <sup>31</sup>As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him. <sup>32</sup>For who is God, save the LORD? and who is a rock, save our God?

translation.original_text: <sup>33</sup>הָאֵ֥ל מָעוּזִּ֖י חָ֑יִל וַיַּתֵּ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים דרכו [דַּרְכִּֽי׃] <sup>34</sup>מְשַׁוֶּ֥ה רגליו [רַגְלַ֖י] כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּמוֹתַ֖י יַעֲמִדֵֽנִי׃ <sup>35</sup>מְלַמֵּ֥ד יָדַ֖י לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְנִחַ֥ת קֶֽשֶׁת־נְחוּשָׁ֖ה זְרֹעֹתָֽי׃ <sup>36</sup>וַתִּתֶּן־לִ֖י מָגֵ֣ן יִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וַעֲנֹתְךָ֖ תַּרְבֵּֽנִי׃ <sup>37</sup>תַּרְחִ֥יב צַעֲדִ֖י תַּחְתֵּ֑נִי וְלֹ֥א מָעֲד֖וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃ <sup>38</sup>אֶרְדְּפָ֥ה אֹיְבַ֖י וָאַשְׁמִידֵ֑ם וְלֹ֥א אָשׁ֖וּב עַד־כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃ <sup>39</sup>וָאֲכַלֵּ֥ם וָאֶמְחָצֵ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יְקוּמ֑וּן וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽי׃ <sup>40</sup>וַתַּזְרֵ֥נִי חַ֖יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֥יעַ קָמַ֖י תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃
translation.text: <sup>33</sup>God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect. <sup>34</sup>He maketh my feet like hinds' feet: and setteth me upon my high places. <sup>35</sup>He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms. <sup>36</sup>Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great. <sup>37</sup>Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip. <sup>38</sup>I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them. <sup>39</sup>And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet. <sup>40</sup>For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.

translation.original_text: <sup>41</sup>וְאֹ֣יְבַ֔י תַּ֥תָּה לִּ֖י עֹ֑רֶף מְשַׂנְאַ֖י וָאַצְמִיתֵֽם׃ <sup>42</sup>יִשְׁע֖וּ וְאֵ֣ין מֹשִׁ֑יעַ אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א עָנָֽם׃ <sup>43</sup>וְאֶשְׁחָקֵ֖ם כַּעֲפַר־אָ֑רֶץ כְּטִיט־חוּצ֥וֹת אֲדִקֵּ֖ם אֶרְקָעֵֽם׃ <sup>44</sup>וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵ֔נִי מֵרִיבֵ֖י עַמִּ֑י תִּשְׁמְרֵ֙נִי֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֔ם עַ֥ם לֹא־יָדַ֖עְתִּי יַעַבְדֻֽנִי׃ <sup>45</sup>בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִתְכַּֽחֲשׁוּ־לִ֑י לִשְׁמ֥וֹעַ אֹ֖זֶן יִשָּׁ֥מְעוּ לִֽי׃ <sup>46</sup>בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְיַחְגְּר֖וּ מִמִּסְגְּרוֹתָֽם׃ <sup>47</sup>חַי־יְהוָ֖ה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְיָרֻ֕ם אֱלֹהֵ֖י צ֥וּר יִשְׁעִֽי׃ <sup>48</sup>הָאֵ֕ל הַנֹּתֵ֥ן נְקָמֹ֖ת לִ֑י וּמוֹרִ֥יד עַמִּ֖ים תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃
translation.text: <sup>41</sup>Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me. <sup>42</sup>They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the LORD, but he answered them not. <sup>43</sup>Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad. <sup>44</sup>Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me. <sup>45</sup>Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me. <sup>46</sup>Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places. <sup>47</sup>The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation. <sup>48</sup>It is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,

translation.original_text: <sup>49</sup>וּמוֹצִיאִ֖י מֵאֹֽיְבָ֑י וּמִקָּמַי֙ תְּר֣וֹמְמֵ֔נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חֲמָסִ֖ים תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃ <sup>50</sup>עַל־כֵּ֛ן אוֹדְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וּלְשִׁמְךָ֖ אֲזַמֵּֽר׃ <sup>51</sup>מגדיל [מִגְדּ֖וֹל] יְשׁוּע֣וֹת מַלְכּ֑וֹ וְעֹֽשֶׂה־חֶ֧סֶד לִמְשִׁיח֛וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֖וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃ פ
translation.text: <sup>49</sup>And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man. <sup>50</sup>Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name. <sup>51</sup>He is the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.
